description: Southco E5-class quarter-turn cam latch as the mechanism it is: a fixed housing (Ø28 flange + double-D barrel keyed to the panel cutout) with a rotating plug running in its bore, the internal compression spring and O-ring the datasheet names, the compressed sealing washer, the mounting nut, the one-sided formed cam driven by the plug's square, and the cam screw.
source: Southco E5 literature e5.en.pdf: p.154 head Ø28x5, cutout 20.1 A/F / Ø22.5, depth behind the head 27.2, cam 45 reach / 23 flat / 19 wide / 4 thick, sealing washer 0.5, panel 1, screw M6, internal O-ring + spring; p.155 long housings 45.5/58.2/68.2; p.156 body thread M22x1.5; p.158 mini; p.170 grip band. Rotating-plug-in-fixed-body architecture per Southco US 6,527,308. Nut/plug/spring proportions scaled off the p.154 section — see NOTES.md.
